commonFine.purpose: Cross-control Pareto and fixed-rule comparison where full structural constituents are not uniformly exposed by authoritative evidence.

dimensions.name: scaleAwareStructure
dimensions.dependency: Production structural composite. Used as the common structural signal only where its constituent vector is not uniformly exposed across controls.

dimensions.name: intensityNcc
dimensions.dependency: Raw photometric ZNCC. intensityScore is excluded because intensityScore=clamp((intensityNcc+0.15)/1.15,0,1).

extendedLocal.purpose: Atomized local-landscape audit only for controls whose authoritative artifact exposes the scale-aware structural constituents.
excludedDerived: raw structure score derived from structureNcc

scoreFamily.S1: Pareto-front priority in commonFine; lower Pareto depth first; S0 descending only as tie-break
scoreFamily.S2: lexicographic: scaleAwareStructure descending, then intensityNcc descending, then S0 descending
scoreFamily.S3: balanced-min = min(scaleAwareStructure, intensityScore); S0 descending tie-break
scoreFamily.S4: equal harmonic agreement = 2*scaleAwareStructure*intensityScore/(scaleAwareStructure+intensityScore), zero when denominator is zero; S0 descending tie-break
scoreFamily.S5: fixed veto: candidates below existing 0.58 structural or 0.42 intensity gate are ineligible; eligible candidates rank by scaleAwareStructure descending, then intensityNcc descending, then S0; ambiguity gate is never lowered and acceptance is reported only when authoritative evidence exposes it

normalization.S3_S4: Production intensityScore transform is the only normalization; it is globally frozen and location-independent. No per-location normalization.

candidateCompatibility.fine: Only fine/local candidates carrying equivalent scale-aware structure and photometric NCC are compared in commonFine.
candidateCompatibility.coarse: Coarse candidates are retained in the machine-readable inventory but analyzed as a separate stage family, never mixed into fine Pareto depth.
candidateCompatibility.combinedOnly: Rows lacking primitive-compatible vectors are inventory-only and excluded from Pareto/scoring evaluation.

classificationRule.SS0: At least half of independently known controls are Pareto-dominated in commonFine, spanning at least two owner-unique controls; no monotonic score-only rescue is claimed.
classificationRule.SS1: At least two-thirds of independent controls are non-dominated and one fixed rule improves multiple owner controls plus Fang Xu without increasing known/static-gate wrong burden.
classificationRule.SS2: Neither SS0 nor SS1; at least one independent control is dominated and at least one is non-dominated.
classificationRule.SS3: Neither SS0/SS1/SS2; alternative rules selectively improve inspected GT while strengthening known false basins or materially regressing Fang Xu.
